caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a vessel with a wide, rounded base and a narrow, short neck that flares out into a flat, circular rim. The vessel is colored in various shades of beige, tan, and light brown, with small patches and a fine crackle pattern suggesting either texture or glazing on the surface. The background of the drawing is a plain light cream or off-white color, creating a neutral setting that emphasizes the object. The overall composition is centered, with the vessel depicted in the middle of the page, and the artist’s signature is visible in small handwriting near the bottom left corner.
title: Butter Mold
